excerpt: The article covers a wide range of neutrino interactions including coherent scattering, neutrino capture, inverse beta decay, low energy nuclear interactions, quasi-elastic scattering, resonant pion production, kaon production, deep inelastic scattering and ultra-high energy interactions.
publisher: arXiv (preprint); J. A. Formaggio, G. P. Zeller
title: From eV to EeV: Neutrino Cross Sections Across Energy Scales
